propositions: Two untracked event JSON files exist in the persistent review-bot clone at paths that predate A6-0b and are not committed to refs/remotes/origin/tickets
The TICKET_DIGEST.json is a superseded unsigned derived cache with older timestamp than seven committed digests for the same ticket and cannot become authoritative
The CLAIM_ENRICH.json is an expired lease claim with expiry time before inspection time and a later superseding claim and DONE event in authoritative history
Both stranded files must be disposed of only if their exact SHA-256 hashes still match recorded values, git status contains exactly these paths, and HEAD equals refs/remotes/origin/tickets
After authorized deletion, the persistent clone must have no untracked event files and HEAD must equal refs/remotes/origin/tickets with no merge, rebase, or stash state
